Getting there

Our whole celebration is at Vista Villa Resorts in Vista, California, about a 45-minute drive north of San Diego International Airport (SAN). We’d suggest flying into SAN and driving up. You can also fly into Carlsbad (McClellan-Palomar Airport, CLD), which is still San Diego County and even closer to the venue. The full address is 29314 Twin Oaks Valley Road, Vista, CA 92084. Car rental tips are on the way, and once your flights are booked, please send your travel itinerary to Cheza so we can help with arrivals.

Where to stay

Good news: your stay is taken care of. Every guest has a room at Vista Villa Resorts for all three nights, and every meal across the three days is included. You’re welcome to stay elsewhere if you’d prefer, and recommendations for places around San Diego are coming soon.

Good to know

A few things to help you plan, especially if you’re coming from out of town.

What should I wear?

Formal attire, please, in light colors and pastels, and no prints. Long gowns and light-colored suits are perfect. Early January here is mild, roughly 45 to 65°F (8 to 19°C) with cool, dry evenings, so bring a layer for after dark.

Is it adults only?

Yes, this one’s an adults-only celebration, so please leave the little ones at home this time.

Do I need to book a room or sort out meals?

No need. Your room at Vista Villa Resorts and every meal across the three days are included. Just let us know if you’d rather stay somewhere else.

What about gifts?

Your presence is the present. With many of you traveling to be there, we truly don’t expect gifts. Just come ready to celebrate.

Traveling from outside the US?

Many visitors can enter under the Visa Waiver Program with an approved ESTA, applied for online before you fly. Please check your own country’s requirements and sort it out early. If you need a formal invitation letter for a visa application, just ask Cheza.

Anything you need from us?

Yes, once your flights are booked, please send your travel itinerary to Cheza so we can help with timing and arrivals. Car rental tips and nearby accommodation options are coming soon.
